interrupted.read: The connection broke before the read finished. Try again once it’s back.
interrupted.request: The connection broke and the request was not confirmed. The task may still be running; check the session history for the result. It is not sent again.

restored.read: Connection restored. The last read did not finish; try again.
restored.request: Connection restored. The last request was not confirmed because of the break. The task may still be running; check the session history for the result. It is not sent again.

invalidUrl: Enter a WebSocket service address without credentials.
loopbackOnly: The offline prototype only connects to a loopback service.
tokenTooShort: The service token is at least 24 characters.
browserSameService: The browser can only connect to this service.
retrying: Can’t reach the service for now. Retrying.
incompatibleMessage: A message from the service is in a format this client doesn’t read; disconnected.
incompatibleHistory: The history is in a format this client doesn’t read; disconnected.
serviceRestarting: The service was upgraded to {{version}} and is restarting. It will reconnect shortly.
nativeEnded: The native connection has ended. Connect again.
historyStalled: No new history for 30 seconds. Try again.
timeout: The request timed out. Check the history for the result; it was not sent again.
switched: Switched sessions; the read was cancelled.
historyIncomplete: The session history has not fully loaded. Reopen the session and try again.

login.title: Connect to the proxy service
login.fingerprintPlaceholder: Leave empty to verify with a CA
login.forgetConfirm: Remove the sign-in record of “{{name}}”? The token, drafts and scheduled tasks saved for it on this computer are removed too; sessions on the service are not affected.
login.otherWindow: “{{name}}” is already signed in in another window; switched to that window.
login.failed: Couldn’t connect to the service. Try again.

upgrade.serviceForceConfirm: Sessions are running on the service {{service}}. Forcing the upgrade restarts the service: replies, commands and approvals waiting for you are interrupted and may need to start over. Continue?
upgrade.serviceConfirm: The service {{service}} will upgrade to the latest release and restart, which takes a few minutes. Continue?
upgrade.serviceDone: The service was upgraded to {{version}} and is restarting; it connects once ready…
upgrade.fromGithub: Download and upgrade to {{version}} from GitHub releases
upgrade.notRestarted: The service hasn’t finished restarting. Click “Connect” in a moment.
upgrade.clientNewer: This client is newer. Upgrade the service first.
upgrade.manualClient: On this system the client is upgraded by hand: download the installer of the service’s version from GitHub releases.
upgrade.preparing: The service is downloading the installer of this version ({{percent}}%). An upgrade button appears here once it’s ready; you can also download it from GitHub releases.
upgrade.refetching: The service doesn’t have this version’s installer yet and is downloading it again; you can also download it from GitHub releases.

connectingWaited.service_other: Connecting to the service, waited {{count}} seconds

downloadingQuiet.service_other: Downloading from the service {{share}}, no new data for {{count}} seconds
downloadingQuiet.github_one: Downloading from GitHub {{share}}, no new data for {{count}} second
downloadingQuiet.github_other: Downloading from GitHub {{share}}, no new data for {{count}} seconds

clientUpgrade.closing: Closing the windows of other connections…
clientUpgrade.installing: Installing; the client opens again when done

web.selfSigned: This service uses a self-signed certificate; make sure the address can be trusted. Import a proper certificate in the desktop client under “Settings → Browser access”, or let a reverse proxy provide HTTPS.
web.ended: The sign-in has ended. Sign in again.
web.title: Sign in to the service workbench
web.totpAdvice: Two-step verification with an authenticator is recommended.

browserTimeout: The connection timed out. Try again.
